scenes.title: The dream and the problem
scenes.narration: Dreaming of a master's degree in Europe? Then the questions start. Which university? Which documents? How do I get the visa? And how much will it all cost?
onscreen: Dreaming of a master's degree in Europe?
Which university? · Which documents? · How do I get the visa? · How much will it all cost?

scenes.title: Meet Estuvia
scenes.narration: Meet Estuvia. The platform that turns studying abroad into a clear, guided plan.
onscreen: Your future starts with a plan.

scenes.title: A personalized journey
scenes.narration: Tell us about your background and pick your destination. Your path becomes rounds and missions, from choosing your master's to arriving in Spain, so you always know your next step.
onscreen: One journey. One step at a time.

scenes.title: Smart guidance
scenes.narration: Stuck? The Estuvia Mentor knows your journey, explains each mission and points you to official sources. Nothing happens without your confirmation.

scenes.title: Agenda AI
scenes.narration: Agenda AI plans your week around your missions and official deadlines, and only adds what you approve.
onscreen: Plan better. Move forward with confidence.

scenes.title: Financial planning
scenes.narration: Plan your money, too. What it costs to prepare, to live there, and what the visa requires you to prove.
onscreen: Plan your studies and your budget.

scenes.title: Documents, housing and travel
scenes.narration: Keep your documents safe, compare housing, plan your trip, and know what to do when you land. All connected to your journey.

scenes.title: Opportunities and community
scenes.narration: Discover opportunities from official sources, and learn from students on the same path.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: Your future starts with a plan. Start your journey today. Estuvia.
